$comment: Site-owned presentation and curation metadata over two deployment-gated contracts: SDK-owned artifacts/evidence and explicit site-owned exceptions. Version, source, provenance, freshness, health, and integrity come from those contracts rather than this narrative manifest.

projection.ownership: The site owns ordering, narrative, routes, and presentation. The SDK owns executable source, the versioned projection, browser artifacts, and evidence.

currentArtifact.notice: Five SDK flagships consume the ec58b44 SDK projection, runtime artifacts, and producer evidence. Every remaining visible transition is an explicit site-owned exception with commit-pinned source, content digests, CSP/attribution admission checks, and an unavailable live-evidence state when no producer observation exists. Evidence older than seven days is visibly stale; a fixture is never substituted as a live claim.

executionStates.label: Fixture
executionStates.description: Deterministic bundled data; no live-service claim.

executionStates.label: Public live
executionStates.description: Reads a public upstream endpoint without a Honua account.

executionStates.label: Demo live
executionStates.description: Reads the deployed demo.honua.io service and reports runtime availability.

executionStates.label: Authenticated
executionStates.description: Requires caller-supplied credentials; no credentials are embedded in this site.

executionStates.label: Degraded
executionStates.description: A live capability is unavailable and the experience says what was reduced.

executionStates.label: Unavailable
executionStates.description: The required source or capability is not currently usable.

executionStates.label: Stale evidence
executionStates.description: The last retained observation is older than the seven-day publication window; its status remains visible but is not a current-health claim.

journeys.title: Connect one dataset, prove three protocols
journeys.userProblem: I already have GIS services and need one application contract instead of protocol-specific rewrites.
journeys.outcome: Run the same spatial and attribute filter through GeoServices, OGC API Features, and OData, then compare the result shape and request evidence.

execution.runtimeState: The page probes every lane and labels live or fixture execution.

journeys.title: Go from endpoint to linked MapLibre views
journeys.userProblem: I need a clear path from a spatial endpoint to a queryable map without hiding capability or execution decisions.
journeys.outcome: Connect, discover, explain, query, and mount one source, then drive the map and table from the same exploration state.

execution.runtimeState: The public route runs the SDK's versioned Honolulu fixture. Separately pinned producer evidence records an anonymous demo.honua.io GeoServices compatibility check, bounded query, and renderable polygon; it does not claim that this static route runs live.

journeys.title: Query 656 MB without downloading it
journeys.userProblem: I need to explore large public GeoParquet in a browser without loading the whole object or hiding what the engine actually read.
journeys.outcome: Run one bounded Oahu query, render results progressively, and inspect measured range, memory, provenance, cache, and timing evidence.
differentiators: self-hosted DuckDB worker, WASM, and extension

execution.runtimeState: The route defaults to a same-origin 1.9 KB fixture with zero cross-origin requests. Selecting AWS explicitly runs the same bounded plan against the pinned anonymous 656,568,610-byte Overture object; rows scanned and row groups pruned remain visibly unverified because DuckDB does not expose them.

journeys.title: Run an incident board that stays honest under failure
journeys.userProblem: Operators need current incidents, hazards, and dispatch context—and must know when the feed is stale or replayed.
journeys.outcome: Connect to the live incident feed by default, observe snapshot and stream state, and watch the board fall back to a clearly labeled scenario replay.

execution.runtimeState: The SDK page probes the deployed stream first. A current anonymous observation reports that realtime feature streams are disabled and require Pro, with no snapshot, cursor, lag, or reconnect result claimed; the page visibly degrades to read-only replay and keeps mutation disabled.

journeys.title: Move from imagery evidence to terrain context
journeys.userProblem: I need imagery, catalogs, elevation, and 3D context without building separate data clients for each source.
journeys.outcome: Browse STAC scenes, compare static and dynamic raster delivery, inspect elevation, then continue into terrain-backed 2.5D buildings.

execution.runtimeState: Individual raster, terrain, and catalog lanes report availability separately.

journeys.title: Move an ArcGIS file without rewriting the application
journeys.userProblem: I need a credible, incremental path away from ArcGIS-specific imports and services.
journeys.outcome: Compare the original file with codemod output, then inspect a migrated layer running against an open Honua endpoint.

execution.runtimeState: The migrated map reports endpoint failure instead of substituting fabricated results.

journeys.title: Review an agent plan before it touches the map
journeys.userProblem: I want natural-language spatial workflows without giving a model an opaque or unrestricted execution path.
journeys.outcome: Validate an untrusted proposal without effects, inspect its typed dry-run plan, approve or narrow one signed single-use read, and verify the resulting receipt.

execution.auth: none; optional live/model lane is host-mediated
execution.runtimeState: The deterministic fixture executes on the static site. Missing host endpoints remain a structured live skip and never substitute fixture output.
